news.title: GOP doubts about Georgia and North Carolina have Republicans shifting focus in battle for Senate
news.summary: Republican hopes of winning Senate races in Georgia and North Carolina have been fading, and the GOP is increasingly focused on playing defense elsewhere with five weeks until the midterm elections
